title: Arrow Out
description: Tap arrow tiles to launch them off a crowded board. Straight and bent arrows need a clear path; bump into another and lose a heart. Five hand-built boards from warm-up to tangle.
controls: Tap an arrow to launch it along its path; hold to preview the path and release to fire. Bent arrows step one cell, then turn. A blocked arrow bounces back and costs one of three hearts.

zh-CN.title: 箭出重围
zh-CN.description: 点箭头把它们从拥挤的棋盘上发射出去。直箭和拐弯箭都要路线畅通，撞上别的箭会丢一颗心。五个手工设计的棋盘，从热身到大缠绕。
zh-CN.controls: 点箭头沿路线发射；按住可预览路线，松手发射。拐弯箭先走一格再转向。被挡住会弹回并扣掉三颗心中的一颗。
